datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Kenya to estimate populations in acute food insecurity under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated at administrative levels to produce current situation assessments of food security impacts during the 2019 period.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates collected through regular enumerator surveys. FEWS NET monitors food security conditions and produces population-level impact assessments in response to drought and other hazards affecting food availability.
